s4.compared: RMS of the RISING cells' full-flat-pool excess increments over each cell's pre-clear window (grid indices strictly before its clear) / RMS of the FLAT rungs' leave-one-out excess increments over the whole grid; both sides target-outside-pool and raw (no rescale), differing only in pool size (n vs n-1), whose matched-scale expectation is sqrt(1 - 1/n^2) -- see pool_size_expected_ratio
